虽然给了差评 但是游戏其实还是挺不错的 画面和风格都挺赞 给差评的主要原因在于游戏长短相对于价格有点太短了 和一个让我个人有些不爽的剧情点 实际上要不是已经好评如潮了，我肯定也是会给好评 一共有80层，每十层一个BOSS 每层大概30秒～1分钟就能过， 全部通关大概也就3～4小时左右 虽然打起来是蛮爽快的 但一次只能带一把武器，不能随时切换武器 作为肉鸽来说几乎没什么BULID选择 处决和飞踢都是同一个键 不能留着处决道具的情况下踢人…… 总的来说，游戏性上没什么深度 没法让人翻来覆去玩上好几遍 所以说4小时不到的流程，68元的价格 确实是有点不太划算 剧情上反而是有些意思，有一些讽刺和深度 可惜没有进一步深挖（不过以这种类型的游戏来说也不用深挖吧） 最让个人不满的是作为封面角色的绿毛妹子…… [spoiler] 居然已经不是处女了呜呜呜呜 而且也没有和男主在一起的描写 也不能作为自机战斗，明明我是因为她长得可爱才买游戏的 [/spoiler] 实在是让人有些不爽啧

It takes 3 hours to beat and you'll be bored by the end of it, because the gameplay is shallow and repetitive. The weapons and upgrades don't do enough to change up the gameplay, and there's a serious lack of variety in the enemies and levels. It's really mindless and doesn't feel rewarding in the same way as similarly fast-paced games like Hotline Miami. I loved the aesthetic and had fun for the first hour or two, but unfortunately the game never really develops beyond that. It's all style and no substance. Maybe get it if it's on sale for $5, but otherwise it's not worth it.

This game is the definition of all style no substance. You've pretty much seen all it has to offer in terms of gameplay after the first floor. None of the weapons really change how you play the game apart from the railgun, but it sucks so you don't ever want to pick it. The roguelike-style percentage chance upgrades don't fit this style of game at all either. You can pretty much never tell when they've actually triggered cause the game is so fast paced and the effects are so marginal. There's also some upgrades, like having the katana do double damage after a kill, which are completely useless as the katana already one-shots everything. Enemy variety is basically non-existent. Every enemy is dealt with by just shooting it as soon as you see it except for one, which deflects bullets at you forcing you to melee it. The story could be neat but the ending really ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ sucks. The game tries to have some sort of message but the ending is just a several minute long monologue that boils down to "consumerism bad"

Mullet Mad Jack and the Prejudiced Stigma Against Robots and Robotic Billionaires In the expansive universe of contemporary media, fictional characters often become icons that influence public perception and societal attitudes. One such character is Mullet Mad Jack, a flamboyant antagonist in the popular dystopian series "CyberWars." Jack, known for his distinctive mullet hairstyle and volatile personality, is notorious for his vehement opposition to robots and robotic billionaires. While he captivates audiences with his dramatic flair and rebellious spirit, Mullet Mad Jack also inadvertently perpetuates a prejudiced stigma against robots and their wealthy creators. This essay examines the multifaceted ways in which Mullet Mad Jack's portrayal contributes to this stigma, highlighting the implications for society's view of technological advancement and artificial intelligence. Mullet Mad Jack's character is crafted with an intricate blend of charisma and menace. His striking mullet, eccentric fashion, and unpredictable behavior make him a compelling figure. However, beneath this surface lies a deep-seated resentment towards robots and the billionaires who create them. Jack's background as a former technician who lost his livelihood to robotic automation serves as a catalyst for his animosity. This narrative taps into real-world fears and anxieties about job displacement and economic disparity caused by technological advancements. Jack's contempt for robots is a central theme in "CyberWars." Throughout the series, he articulates a viewpoint that robots are soulless machines designed to usurp human roles and devalue human labor. This perspective resonates with certain segments of the audience who harbor similar fears. By depicting robots as the enemy, Mullet Mad Jack reinforces a prejudiced view that ignores the potential benefits of robotic technology, such as increased efficiency, safety, and the ability to perform tasks beyond human capability. The oversimplified narrative that robots are solely responsible for societal issues fosters a climate of fear and resistance to innovation. Equally significant is Jack's portrayal of robotic billionaires. Characters like Dr. Axelrod, a genius inventor and billionaire, are depicted as cold, calculating, and indifferent to the plight of ordinary people. Mullet Mad Jack's vendetta against such figures paints them as the archetypal villains who prioritize profit over humanity. This depiction feeds into existing stereotypes of the "evil billionaire" and amplifies distrust towards those who drive technological progress. It overlooks the philanthropic efforts and contributions to society made by many innovators and entrepreneurs in the real world. The influence of Mullet Mad Jack extends beyond the screen. His character reflects and amplifies societal anxieties about the rapid pace of technological change and the growing economic divide. By encouraging a prejudiced stigma against robots and robotic billionaires, Jack's narrative can hinder the acceptance and integration of beneficial technologies. It may also contribute to the stigmatization of individuals and groups associated with technological innovation, creating barriers to progress and collaboration. Mullet Mad Jack's larger-than-life persona and fervent opposition to robots and robotic billionaires make for gripping storytelling. However, his portrayal also reinforces prejudiced stigmas that can have real-world repercussions. As society navigates the complexities of technological advancement, it is crucial to recognize and address the nuanced impacts of such fictional characters. By fostering a more balanced and informed perspective, we can better appreciate the potential of robots and their creators to contribute positively to our world.

The splashy graphical style will grab you at first but it obscures the fact that the hitboxes in this game are busted trash. Lord help if you need to remove chains from a door with the pistol or rifle; I have spend upwards of 7 seconds in such scenarios emptying entire clips with the crosshair set dead-center on the chains from both respective weapons and ended up hitting NOTHING and then dying for it. And this happens ALL THE TIME. And anytime you wanna target a a fire extinguisher near enemies? Suddenly their hitboxes inflates to six or seven feet away from themselves, and dead-center shots on FEs that SHOULD net me an explosive multikill just turn into plinking chest shots for 1 sec. This happens with such consistency I wonder if it isn't intentional. tl;dr an incredibly good looking and aesthetically-realized dysfunction that clearly leans on it's vibes to cover up utterly busted hitbox functionality.

All style, no substance. This game clearly draws heavy inspiration from Post Void, but it fails to capture what made that game so good. The great 80's anime art style looks fantastic, but the gameplay lacks impact. Most weapons and power-ups feel underpowered or outright ineffective, forcing you to repeatedly restart in the hopes of getting a viable combination (for example, the shotgun + ricochet combo). With over a thousand other games to play, this one simply doesn’t justify the time or effort. It’s flashy, but ultimately hollow.

Only get on sale. - $20 USD for 1 - 2 hrs of gameplay, if you want to 100% achievements you can get a few more hours - Main attraction is the art & over the top anime story, which is good but hardly much of it, just a few quick cutscenes, this game is just another novelty to be forgotten in less than 24 hours - Meanwhile gameplay, the main part of the game is very basic & very rushed, repetitive, same few repeating levels, it is an endless rush to the exit with only 10 secs of life, true point A to B gameplay, extended by getting kills, straight up lacking. Terrible balanced guns, like the Railgun Sniper is so useless when have only 10 secs of life and need to spam shots and race to the exit, shotgun is just completely OP by far, no reason to not use it, spamming body onee shots, kills bosses extremely fast, there is little reward for landing headshots for 1 secs of extra time. - Spend 50% of your time in loading & animations: Most levels only take 20+ secs to complete, sometimes only 10+ secs, yet the loading between levels, wait for animations & selecting perks waste 10+ secs, so for every 20 secs of gameplay there is 10+ secs of loading & animations. Most of the perks are EXTREMELY underwhelming and pretty useless, all you really need is your main gun, the perks also only last for 10 levels anyway so who cares, the gun is what carries on. Also some perks actually do nothing like "Silent Protagonist" or "Noisy Protagonist" which just affects your voicelines, just more bloat.

I've played a lot of games in my time and not a lot of boomer shooters i'll be honest. I played DOOM and DOOM Eternal and they are my closest boomer shooters. Let me start off with this game is great, levels are segmented in short bursts with a little roguelike perk system in the end of each level. The story is fascinating and the speed of the game is awesome. If you are looking for a really easy pick up and kill a few minutes then this game is definitely going to scratch that itch. Game is worth buying full price just to support the devs who did a absolutey amazing job with a game the is great in both atmosphere, aesthetic and gameplay. What a unique gem!

A fun but rough gem. For a indie project, it is extremely polished, has a great gameplay loop, great visuals and decent music. There are some issues however: 1. The MOST MASSIVE ISSUE AT THE TIME OF THIS REVIEW IS THAT THIS GAME PROBABLY HAS A MEMORY LEAK. IF YOU PLAY FOR LONG PERIODS OF TIME IT WILL START TO STUTTER AND YOU WILL LOSE FRAMES WHICH WILL LOSE YOU RUNS. Restarting the game seems to fix it. 2. Like a good 40% of the upgrades feel useless compared to others, same goes for guns. 3. The upgrade system for endless mode feels bad, just overriding your 1st upgrade with the newest one after 10 upgrades. Either let me switch out an upgrade or let me have infinite upgrades. 4. The game is kinda short: main story will take you 1-2h tops, but there's enough secondary content for maybe 10 hours before it gets stale. 很早就被此游合成器浪潮&复古未来（风味90s）的表皮所吸引。流程很短，但短得不亏。 人机对立让人想起终结者，不过天网偏运动，本作偏商务。AI控制的机器人用奶头乐和消费主义圈养人类，网络飞升的赛博人10s得不到多巴胺就得光速去世。 反叛被包装成了商业活动，妄图打破规则的主角则将自身性命绑给了直播间（直播公司霸王条款）：不杀人→观众得不到刺激→直播间无人点赞→多巴胺注射系统10s内被切断→主角暴毙。 换句话说，这种绝对狠活儿直播，玩家10秒内不杀人就会死。此游的基调就是短·平·快，平均不到一分钟就能通完1层，每10层刷出一个boss + 特色动画小演出。后期厮杀敌人基本都是条件反射般地——速杀/处决/环境击杀，偶尔电光火石间地选择玩点花样，配合build能适当延长秒数（续命）。 本作地图设计也是全方位配合这种快节奏战斗，除去象征性的小分岔，四舍五入就是一条大路直通出口，没有找钥匙只有破门，唯一的解谜可能是你得琢磨着怎么快点延长自己只有10s的生命。难得有这种略去了跑图、解谜、甚至连切武器花样击杀也无需考虑，玩得大脑褶皱都快被抚平了的FPS肉鸽爽游。关于肉鸽部分，你甚至都不怎么需要考虑build。 当然坏处就是玩法较浅，腻得略快。然而短流程又弥补了这个短板，如果并不反感花五六十买个4h左右流程的游戏，那么本作值得考虑购入。 顺便，赛博朋克风必备典中典元素： [list] [*]自个儿掏腰包在广告时间用工资升级装备武器 [*]脑袋别在裤腰带上的奖励是印有大大CONSUME logo的球鞋 [*]被爆头后考虑到直播间收益，将你的大脑修复到了95% [*][spoiler]你以为在反叛垄断大公司，其实主角战斗和追寻的“意义”已被提前设定好了[/spoiler] [/list] 这种高科技，低低低生活是有股子黑色幽默劲的。配合欧美风味Anime画面，也能在突突突之余，发掘品味别样乐（恶）趣。 （彩蛋） 武器成就刚好能摆出个： M U L L E T ——“鲻鱼头Time！（Streamer音）”

I'm a little over half way through the game and I have to say this is some of the most fun I've had with an FPS in a long time. I remember really enjoying Katana Zero, which had this sort of fast paced high energy lots of deaths gameplay, and this takes that and ports that style into a completely new environment and genre. You feel insane adrenaline running through the stages and ending bot after bot. The art direction is awesome too, although I would have perhaps preferred the colours being a bit more muted. It does look like something out of a late 80s early 90s OVA. The themes of the story are pretty cool too, if you like Cyberpunk and stories which explore the implications of the overreach of technology on human connection and expression, this is right up your alley. It's certainly far more zaney than something like Cyberpunk, but it is entertaining and gets its point across I feel. The only thing I might kind of level criticism against is the wall running, which I feel needs some work. It's not bad, but the sheer pace of the game makes it a bit awkward to control on those sections. Nonetheless, I recommend without hesitation. You should play this game.
